On-screen text first reads 'Couples at the start of a relationship,' and he performs an affectionate phone call, smiling and saying loving things like 'I can't wait to see you' and 'I've missed you today.' The text then changes to 'vs couples months/ years in,' and his demeanor shifts to annoyed and impatient.
